tool: Chromium (Playwright) run by the author; page text kept privately, hashed here

Equiton.headline: No H1; the hero reads "Professionally managed real estate. Built for individual investors." with "Grow your wealth with private real estate investing from Equiton."
Equiton.products: Monthly Income Fund, Apartment Fund, US Apartment Fund, Residential Growth Fund I, Income & Development Fund (fund page only), and development offerings (TEN99 Broadview, Wilson Station Condos, Bridleview Residences; Sandstones and Vicinity labelled funded or closed)
Equiton.returns: All labelled targets, on the investor page: "7-9%" Monthly Income Fund, "8-12%" Apartment Fund and US Apartment Fund, "10-14%" Residential Growth Fund I ("Over 5+ years"), "16-20%" development offerings ("Targeted Average Annual Net Return (Realized upon project completion)")
Equiton.minimum: $25,000 for all its funds, according to the author, who has worked with Equiton. The website wording seen names it for development offerings: "Investing in an Equiton development requires a $25,000 minimum investment" (supplied by the author on 3 November 2026, page address not recorded); the three pages read state no minimum for the other funds.

corrections.text: The 2 November record said the pages read stated no minimum investment. Read again on 3 November 2026, the Centurion Apartment REIT page states "The minimum investment is $25,000." The record and the glance table were corrected.

The $25,000 minimum was added on the author's information: Equiton's website wording names it for development offerings, and the author reports it applies to all its funds. The three pages read on 2 November do not state a minimum.
